title: Passive Voice (Present)
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Has aprendido a usar la Voz Pasiva, una estructura fundamental en el inglés corporativo.

parts.visual:
Usamos la Voz Pasiva cuando la acción (qué pasa) es más importante que quién la hace. 
Estructura: Objeto + verbo To Be (am/is/are) + verbo en Participio.
parts.audio: We use the Passive Voice when the action is more important than who does it. Structure: The object, plus the verb To Be in present, plus the main verb in past participle.

parts.visual:
Ejemplos: Activa: The cleaner cleans the office (El limpiador limpia la oficina). 
Pasiva: The office IS CLEANED every day (La oficina es limpiada todos los días). 
Los productos SON ENVIADOS = The products ARE SHIPPED.
parts.audio: Examples. Active voice: The cleaner cleans the office. Passive voice: The office IS CLEANED every day. Another example: The products ARE SHIPPED.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta para completar la oración en voz pasiva.

questions.question: The office ____ cleaned every evening. (Es limpiada).
Our products ____ manufactured in China. (Son fabricados).
English is ____ all over the world. (Hablado - Participio).
The emails ____ sent automatically by the system. (Son enviados).
This software is ____ by millions of people. (Usado).
The report ____ written by the manager. (Es escrito).
The meetings are ____ every Monday. (Mantenidas/Sostenidas - Participio).
Passwords are ____ every 90 days. (Cambiadas).
I am ____ to work weekends. (Se me pide / Soy pedido).
The factory ____ located in Germany. (Está ubicada).
The bills are ____ at the end of the month. (Pagadas).
My salary ____ deposited on the 15th. (Es depositado).
The computers are ____ by IT support. (Arregladas).
This rule ____ applied to everyone. (No es aplicada - Negativo).
Taxes ____ included in the final price. (No están incluidos).
____ the office cleaned on Sundays? (¿Es limpiada? - Pregunta).
The goods are ____ to the warehouse. (Llevadas/Transportadas - Taken).
Our coffee ____ imported from Colombia. (Es importado).
A lot of money ____ spent on advertising. (Es gastado).
Employees are ____ free lunch. (Se les da / Son dados).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe 'is' o 'are', seguido del verbo en participio.

questions.question: The office ____ cleaned. (Es - singular)
The emails ____ sent. (Son - plural)
English is ____. (Hablado - participio de speak)
The bills are ____. (Pagadas - participio de pay)
Our products ____ manufactured here. (Son - plural)
The meetings are ____ on Monday. (Mantenidas - participio de hold)
The factory ____ located in Germany. (Está - singular)
Employees are ____ lunch. (Dados - participio de give)
Passwords are ____. (Cambiadas - participio regular)
The rule ____ applied. (No es - is not contraído)

pairs.target: A ellos se les da (Son dados)
